headline: Executive order directs federal action on new kinds of firearms threats and on how schools run active-shooter drills.
what_it_does: This executive order, signed by President Biden, focuses on two topics named in its title: newer or emerging threats involving firearms, and active-shooter drills held in schools. Executive orders usually instruct federal agencies to study issues, issue guidance, or take other steps within their existing powers. No summary was provided, so the specific actions, agencies, and deadlines are not described here.

who_it_affects.how: The order aims to change or improve how schools plan and carry out active-shooter drills.

who_it_affects.group: Federal agencies that handle firearms and school safety
who_it_affects.how: They are likely directed to take steps on emerging firearms threats and school drill practices, though the details are not given in the source material.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed September 26, 2024; specific agency deadlines are not stated in the available material.
